name: 日付で区切る検索履歴
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
ONE targeted typography correction for LH01-0008. Image1 is generated candidate. Image2 ORIGINAL controls icon geometry, proportions, optical weight, layout alignment and fine details. Image3 rough localized mock is secondary Japanese-copy and Regular-font reference.
Change ONLY Japanese text weight: all four row titles, date and bottom action must use delicate Meiryo REGULAR weight400, never bold/semibold. Match the fine normal letter strokes in image3. Keep same font sizes/lineheight: date12/16, row14/24, metadata12/16, action14/24 at logical390px width uniformly scaled. Do not enlarge text, alter wrapping or invent a heading.
Preserve exact current content: 今日; 代々木公園 / 東京都渋谷区; 地域の図書館 / 東京都渋谷区; 交流スペース / 東京都新宿区; 宿泊施設 with NO subtitle; 検索履歴をもっと見る.
Keep ALL other pixels/structure as close as possible:4neutral-clock history rows, original source glyph details, left-inset separators aligned with text, purewhite #FFFFFF card/canvas, soft neutral border/shadow, same compact geometry and original-style clock silhouettes. Accent decision unchanged: gray/slate neutral history icons, only actual More-history CTA forest-green gradient #174C36→#1F6444→#2D8F5E with white regular text. No other accent, selected state, tints, new controls or content. Portrait3:4 flat frontal UI.
reviewNotes: Regularの細い文字へ修正し今日、4行、3つの住所と最後の住所なし、追加履歴操作の日本語全文を再確認。原参照優先の時計と本文からの区切り線保持。灰色履歴アイコン、実際の導線だけ森林緑、白面と欠けなし。静止画像エージェントレビューのみ、所有者承認・厳密フォント一致・ネイティブ編集・実装は未証明。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
